question: When did Dipa Karmakar win the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in Gymnastics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2016**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Dipa Karmakar **is an **Indian artistic gymnast **who gained significant recognition for her performances.
 
• She was awarded the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in 2016**, India's highest sporting honor.
 
• Dipa is known for her exceptional performance in the 2016 Rio Olympics, where she finished fourth in the women's vault gymnastics event.
 
• She became the first Indian female gymnast to compete in the Olympics and achieve such a high ranking.
 
• The Khel Ratna Award recognizes outstanding achievements in the field of sports by Indian athletes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award**

 
 
• It is the highest sporting honor in India, named after the legendary hockey player Major Dhyan Chand.
 
• The award was instituted in 1991-1992 to honor athletes for their outstanding performance in sports.
 
• Recipients of this award receive a medallion, a certificate, and a cash prize.
 
• It is awarded annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India.
 
 
 
• **Dipa Karmakar's Career Highlights**
 
 
• Born on 9 August 1993 in Agartala, Tripura, India.
 
• She is one of the few gymnasts in the world to successfully execute the Produnova vault, known for its high difficulty level.
 
• Dipa has won multiple medals at various international competitions, including the Commonwealth Games and Asian Gymnastics Championships.
 
• She was conferred with the Padma Shri, India's fourth-highest civilian award, in 2017.
 
 
 
• **2016 Rio Olympics**
 
 
• The 2016 Summer Olympics were held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, from August 5 to August 21.
 
• It marked India's largest-ever delegation to the Olympics with 117 athletes competing in 15 sports.
 
• Dipa Karmakar's performance in the women's vault final brought her international acclaim despite narrowly missing out on a medal.
 
• Her achievement was widely celebrated in India, highlighting the potential of Indian athletes in gymnastics.
